title: Certificates of Deposit: Adding Principal During a Term
content:
Most Certificates of Deposit at Piedmont Crescent Bank take their money once, at opening, and again only in a grace period. This page covers the exception: new principal added in the middle of a term.

## Rule

Outside a grace period, a certificate takes new principal only if its tier allows at least one in-term add-on. The certificate must be in active status for such an add-on to be taken, and every one of these limits must be respected:

- each add-on is at least the tier's smallest in-term add-on;
- the number of in-term add-ons posted since the current term's start date stays within the tier's count;
- the sum of those add-ons stays within the tier's total for the term;
- after the add-on, the certificate's principal does not exceed the tier's largest principal for one certificate.

## Effect of an accepted add-on

The added money earns the certificate's existing rate from the day it posts. The maturity date does not move, and the Jumbo Bonus is not re-tested because of the add-on.

## Tier settings

| Tier | In-term add-ons per term | Smallest in-term add-on | Most added during one term |
|---|---|---|---|
| 6-Month Certificate | 0 | not applicable | not applicable |
| 11-Month No-Penalty Certificate | 0 | not applicable | not applicable |
| 12-Month Certificate | 0 | not applicable | not applicable |
| 18-Month Bump-Up Certificate | 1 | USD 100.00 | USD 25000.00 |
| 36-Month Certificate | 0 | not applicable | not applicable |
| 60-Month Certificate | 0 | not applicable | not applicable |

## Input, judgement, outcome (hypothetical)

| Input | Judgement | Outcome |
|---|---|---|
| 12-Month Certificate, active, owner offers USD 5000.00 mid-term | Tier allows no in-term add-on | Not accepted |
| 18-Month Bump-Up Certificate, active, no add-on this term, USD 20000.00 offered, principal stays within the tier's largest principal | Within count, within the term total, above the smallest add-on | Accepted; the rate and maturity date are unchanged |
| 18-Month Bump-Up Certificate, active, one add-on already posted this term | Count for the term used up | Not accepted |
| 18-Month Bump-Up Certificate, active, USD 80.00 offered | Below the smallest add-on | Not accepted |

## Point of judgement

**Does an add-on large enough to pass the Jumbo Bonus threshold add that bonus to the running term?** No; the add-on never triggers a fresh Jumbo Bonus test.
